note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 5176 Section 3.2 and HEAD code (coa.go answerRequest). TestRFC5176ServiceTypeNAKed sends a valid CoA-Request with Service-Type 17 (Authorize Only) and asserts CoA-NAK (not CoA-ACK), Error-Cause 405 and zero bus events, then sends the identical request without Service-Type and asserts CoA-ACK. Covers both the MUST-NAK/MUST-NOT-ACK rule and the SHOULD 405 for a NAS that declines optional Authorize Only.
